title: 48 Teams
style: Trap-pop anthem with rapid clap percussion, booming low end, and crowd-ready hook sections; verse drives with athletic rap, pre-chorus lifts into stacked high harmonies, chorus slams with duet chants and gang vocals, bridge opens wide with a soaring lift before the final shout-back. Bright, punchy, stadium-sized mix with crisp ad-libs and explosive transitions., flamenco, deep, rap, loud, world
lyrics:
[Intro]
48 teams…
biggest World Cup ever!
Clap clap clap…
let’s go!

[Chorus]
48 teams! Clap clap!
Biggest World Cup on the map!
48 teams! Clap clap!
Sing it back, don’t hold that back!
From Canada to Japan
Morocco to Brazil
48 nations, one big thrill!
Clap clap clap! Pa pa pa!
World Cup 2026 — that’s a fact!

[Verse 1]
Hosts in the house —
Canada, Mexico, USA
AFC step up —
Japan, Korea, Australia
Africa bringing fire —
Morocco, Senegal, Egypt, Ghana
South America legends —
Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia
Europe stacked —
France, Germany, England, Spain, Portugal
48 teams deep,
this tournament is mental!

[Chorus]
48 teams! Clap clap!
Biggest World Cup on the map!
48 teams! Clap clap!
Sing it back, don’t hold that back!
From Canada to Japan
Morocco to Brazil
48 nations, one big thrill!
Clap clap clap! Pa pa pa!
World Cup 2026 — that’s a fact!

[Bridge]
From the beaches to the mountains,
every flag in the air
48 dreams,
one trophy to share
48… teams…
World Cup…
BASS DROP BOOM BOOM BOOM!

[Final Chorus]
48 teams! Clap clap!
(Too right!)
Biggest World Cup — sing it back!
(マジで！)
48 teams! Clap clap!
Pa pa pa!
48 nations — let’s go, let’s go!
48 teams! Clap clap!
Biggest World Cup on the map!
Clap clap clap! Pa pa pa!
World Cup 2026 — that’s a fact!

[Outro]
48 teams…
World Cup 2026…
Clap clap…
sing it everywhere…
Biggest one ever!
